anchors.name: a1-arrival
anchors.note: The establishing frame. Wall foreshortened, tower left of centre, sodium pool right.

anchors.name: a2-wall-raking
anchors.note: Moon rakes the rustication. Tests the limestone normal + per-block colour variance.

anchors.name: a3-tower-up
anchors.note: Looking up the tower shaft to the corbel collar and glazed cab. Silhouette test.

anchors.name: a4-sodium-pool
anchors.note: Warm/cool split. Tests bloom restraint, tone mapping and asphalt roughness.

anchors.name: a5-trench
anchors.note: The drainage trench entry, read from the approach: a genuine cut in the ground running under the wall. Tests the ground aperture, coping stones, wet stone and standing water.
